local_review.finding_body: The contribution put `--enable-url-protocols=https` in `src/test/resources/META-INF/native-image/.../native-image.properties`, violating the test contract's prohibition on test-authored Native Image configuration files. Removing it reproduced the underlying need in the GraalVM 25 lane: every OAuth scenario using the dependency's `GenericUrl` HTTPS path failed with `MalformedURLException` requesting that exact protocol option, while the non-URL HMAC test passed.
local_review.finding_title: Native Image flag was bundled as test metadata
local_review.fix_note: Deleted the forbidden `native-image.properties` and moved the narrowly required HTTPS protocol build argument into the coordinate's `graalvmNative.binaries.test` configuration in `build.gradle`, where test-only build flags belong. The stable finalization pass verified the repaired tree.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test sources, build configuration, index and reported statistics under the library-new-request rules. The tests exercise the public OAuth APIs without native skips, version-pinned assertions, package bypasses, direct reflection, external network access, or scaffold code. The reported dynamic-access result is the valid 0/0 no-calls case, so no percentage or entry-count mismatch gate applies. After the repair, the exact Forge finalization command passed all three native lanes, metadata validation, test-only metadata splitting, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
